notes:
One card for up to four children, each with their own name
Add Customer and Edit Customer take the other children's names
Start Play asks who is playing, and time is charged for each child playing
Active Sessions, Play History and session recovery show who played and how many
Search finds a customer by any child's name
WhatsApp welcome and expiry messages name every child on the card
Names, mobile numbers and card IDs can be selected and copied
Forgot PIN? on Settings PIN and Settings WhatsApp
Wording fixes: messages speak of one Admin PIN
